name: geml
description: The official GEML marketplace — two plugins for Claude Code: geml authors, validates and blockwise-edits GEML documents, and gemflow runs a coding agent through the stages of a GEML workflow.

plugins.name: geml
plugins.description: Author, validate, and blockwise-edit GEML documents, and navigate a project's call graph as GEML codemaps: two skills plus the geml MCP server (runs via npx @geml/geml, no separate install).

plugins.name: gemflow
plugins.description: Workflow stages for Claude Code: a line above the prompt, a board, /gemflow and three tools (status, move, set) over a GEML statechart; a tool dictionary binds each stage's uses to the project's tools; evidence is written from test, PR, CI and deploy results; a tool is refused only where its use is not declared.
